bio.text: David Gowan represents Legislative District 19 in the Arizona Senate and lives in Sierra Vista; he chairs the Senate Military Affairs and Border Security Committee.
According to his legislative biography, he was first elected to the Arizona House of Representatives in 2009 and served as its 52nd Speaker during the 2015-2017 session.

The biography says he later served in the Senate, chairing the Senate Appropriations Committee from 2019 to 2022, and holds a B.A. in secondary education and social studies from the University of Arizona.
